description: One exact hologram, many views, for .NET. The Pleroma stores items (a key plus optional flag word, arrangement and time tick) in one fixed array of finite-field harmonics and answers exact counts per key and whole items, refusing past capacity instead of answering wrongly, plus exact counts per flag word, Hamming near-counts and nearest words, counts per arrangement and per tick, opt-in joint counts over flags, order and time, and the count of items whose flag word satisfies any predicate (one read, per tick or arrangement too), all at any load. The whole store relabels flags and arrangements, shifts keys, ages and diffuses over time in place, with every view still exact, and applies a weighted superposition of flag flips, arrangement relabellings and time shifts (PleromaKernel) in one pass whose cost does not depend on how many it holds; two stores bind in one pass (keys add, flag words XOR, arrangements compose), and Attend reads one flag query three ways at once (exact counts per value, shares summing to 1, parity of the count); an opt-in complete key band adds key scaling and the Chinese-remainder join of two stores, stores without per-bit item lines take Frobenius squaring and linear shift-register steps on their flag words, and exact reads give Hamming syndrome counts, an integer independence test of joint counts and a draw from any view's exact shares; several primes per cell and an optional fading complex component are supported. At equal storage against Plate's HRR it recovered 16x the items exactly and gave 0% wrong answers past capacity. RelationFace reads the holonomy of any loop of stored relations in one linear read and the exact circulation direction of a loop of rational rates, and ChargeLattice reads integer charges from the carries of a periodic lattice's loop sums, with an exact merge law. CycleHologram is the keys-only special case (exact multiset, replica reconciliation by subtracting holograms). Beneath both, the phasor Vector Symbolic Architecture (VSA) codec: bind, unbind, bundle and correlate over unit-complex faces, with a frozen-identity codec for models and a width-configurable SIMD codec for storage and similarity search.
title: Phasor
